title: Enforce read-only Gemini plan-mode delegation and map Gemini agent door tools
summary: Passes an ephemeral user-tier --policy TOML to gemini --approval-mode plan in delegate.mjs so exit_plan_mode, enter_plan_mode, write_file, replace and run_shell_command are denied while mcp_ia_* door tools are allowed non-interactively; preserves declared mcp_ia_* door tools in generated Gemini CLI agent allowlists; and fixes the README Gemini extension install command.
